# Silo

> Silo is a free, open-source mod manager for Farming Simulator 25 (FS25). More farming,
> less fixing: it reads your mods and your game log, ranks mods by the errors they logged when
> the game crashes, flags conflicts before launch, and unifies ModHub and GitHub into one
> cross-source catalog. Organize shows every move before it touches a file, and Restore vanilla
> layout puts every mod back in your mods folder.

Silo is a native desktop app for Windows, with macOS and Linux builds in preview. No account,
no ads, no telemetry, open source (MIT). Its catalog is served by a public read-only API
(SiloAPI) that aggregates mod metadata, versions, popularity and descriptions from ModHub and
GitHub.

## What Silo does
- Crash & log triage: reads `log.txt`, separates real errors from noise, and ranks mods by the errors they logged
- Conflict detection: flags more than one active map before launch, plus colliding filltypes, vehicle types and scripts
- Cross-source catalog: one canonical record per mod across ModHub and GitHub, with the latest version across both
- Guided bisection: automates "disable half, relaunch" to isolate a bad mod, then restores your set
- Loadouts: files zips into a local archive; switching a mod on or off adds or removes its link in the game's flat mods folder right away (copies on cloud-synced folders)
- Collections: share a mod set as a link (secret gist or public repo); others preview it against their library and import it as a loadout
- Filltype bridge: generates a companion mod that teaches equipment a stubborn map filltype
- Any mods folder: follows FS25's mods-folder override, or pick any folder (optionally pointing the game at it, with a backup)
- Library archive on any drive: move parked mods to another drive with verified, pausable, cancellable moves
- Integrity check: compares an installed mod with the build its source published (provenance, not antivirus); covers GitHub mods and ModHub mods the catalog has already hashed
- Installs GitHub releases in one click; ModHub mods are downloaded from ModHub

## Principles
- Free and open source: the desktop app's source is on GitHub (MIT); the catalog server is a separate hosted service
- No account, no ads, no telemetry. Silo contacts its catalog only when you search Browse, open a mod's details, check for updates or verify a mod; it also checks GitHub for its own app updates at launch, which sends no library data. Server access logs are kept 30 days; only aggregate counts are published
- Never edits inside a mod; Organize shows every move before it touches a file; Restore vanilla layout puts every mod back in the mods folder; updates keep the previous version in backups/; backs up before writing settings or saves
- Acts through your own GitHub account; ModHub pages open in your browser
